title: Downloading Location and Sublocation Information to a CSV File

blocks.text: To download a CSV file of locations and sublocations:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Location Management > Legacy Locations.
You can download only one file per hour. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
If you have thousands of locations, then it takes more time to download all the available locations.

blocks.text: The CSV file you download here cannot be used to import location and sublocation modifications because it uses a different format. If you need to import a CSV file to make modifications to locations, be sure to use the same format as the Sample Import CSV file provided by Zscaler.
